Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the internal numbers and want to explore moving from Compact -> Throughput for our production cluster later this quarter. Two quick asks before we schedule a deeper call:

- We need to preserve our existing HIPAA audit log retention (90 days) and the enhanced KV cache retention bundle — those are contractual requirements for a subset of workflows.
- We want to understand how pro‑rata pricing and seat equivalence will work if we upgrade mid‑billing cycle, and what (if any) credits or pilot discounts Redwood can offer for the first 90 days.

Subject: Re: Tier change question — keeping audit & cache features

Hi Elena — really appreciate the context and the CSV — that helps a lot. High level options so we can pick during the call:

1) Straight upgrade (Compact -> Throughput)
   - Feature preservation: We can pin the HIPAA audit log retention and KV cache retention as contractual addenda so they stay at current levels. No functional changes.
   - Billing: pro‑rata charged for the remainder of your billing cycle based on Throughput list price; tokens already consumed in the billing month are not double billed.

2) Temporary Burst + Add‑on (3 month pilot)
   - Keep Compact as the baseline, attach a temporary Throughput add‑on pool for peak workloads. Keeps baseline price predictable.
   - We can include a 15% pilot discount on the add‑on for 90 days and roll usage into a Throughput subscription at renewal if you choose.

Recommended approach (what we typically do): run a 90‑day add‑on pilot so you can validate latency/cost before committing to a full tier upgrade. If you need guaranteed capacity immediately, upgrade and we’ll draft an amendment that explicitly preserves the two required features.

I attached a draft amendment and a simple cost delta model — I’ll run numbers with Karthik and loop back tomorrow with a conservative monthly delta based on your CSV.

Next steps:
- Would you be available Thu 3 Jun 10:00 PT to walk through the options + numbers?
- If procurement wants to join, cc them here (I see procurement@mediflow.com is on the thread).

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0124
